headline_marked: Mbappe scores as [[France leads Sweden at halftime]] in World Cup clash
headline: Mbappe scores as France leads Sweden at halftime in World Cup clash
summary: France makes strategic lineup changes on the left flank as they face Sweden in the Round of 32.
details: Kylian Mbappe's goal has put France in the lead as they head into the halftime break against Sweden in their World Cup last-32 match.
Coach Didier Deschamps implemented several changes to the starting lineup, reshuffling the left flank with Lucas Digne and Bradley Barcola starting.
Digne replaced Theo Hernandez, while Barcola took the spot of Desire Doue in the attack.
In defense, William Saliba returned to the center-back position after being rested in the previous match against Norway.
The midfield saw Adrien Rabiot reclaim his starting spot alongside Aurelien Tchouameni, with Manu Kone moving to the bench.
Sweden countered with Lucas Bergvall starting in midfield and Victor Lindelof shifting back into central defense.
The match remains critical as both teams fight for a ticket to the final 16 of the tournament.
caption:
Mbappe strikes! France takes the lead against Sweden in a high-stakes World Cup battle.

Kylian Mbappe's goal has put France in the lead as they head into the halftime break against Sweden in their World Cup last-32 match.

Coach Didier Deschamps implemented several changes to the starting lineup, reshuffling the left flank with Lucas Digne and Bradley Barcola starting.

Digne replaced Theo Hernandez, while Barcola took the spot of Desire Doue in the attack.

In defense, William Saliba returned to the center-back position after being rested in the previous match against Norway.

The midfield saw Adrien Rabiot reclaim his starting spot alongside Aurelien Tchouameni, with Manu Kone moving to the bench.

Sweden countered with Lucas Bergvall starting in midfield and Victor Lindelof shifting back into central defense.

The match remains critical as both teams fight for a ticket to the final 16 of the tournament.

headline_marked: Govt [[drafting new pay scale gazette]] for public servants
headline: Govt drafting new pay scale gazette for public servants
summary: The government is currently working on a draft gazette to determine the salary structures for various grades of government employees.
details: The Bangladesh government is in the process of drafting a new pay scale gazette. This document will outline the new salary structures and benefits for public servants across different grades.
The draft is being prepared to ensure a fair and updated compensation package for government employees, reflecting current economic conditions.
Once the draft gazette is finalized and approved, it will be officially published, providing clarity on how much each grade of employee will receive in terms of basic pay and allowances.
Government employees across the country are awaiting the announcement of the new pay scale to understand the impact on their overall monthly income.
caption:
A new pay scale for government employees is in the works. Here is what is happening.

The Bangladesh government is in the process of drafting a new pay scale gazette. This document will outline the new salary structures and benefits for public servants across different grades.

The draft is being prepared to ensure a fair and updated compensation package for government employees, reflecting current economic conditions.

Once the draft gazette is finalized and approved, it will be officially published, providing clarity on how much each grade of employee will receive in terms of basic pay and allowances.

Government employees across the country are awaiting the announcement of the new pay scale to understand the impact on their overall monthly income.
